evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official Freeport East tax-site maps identify Gateway 14 as a designated tax site. Regulation 2(1)(b) of The Designation of Freeport Tax Sites (Freeport East) Regulations 2021 (UKSI 2021/1389) designates the area shown edged and hatched in red on the map entitled 'Tax Site 2: Gateway 14, Mid-Suffolk' dated 25 November 2021. The designation took effect on 30 December 2021, and the explanatory note names the area the 'Gateway 14 Tax Site'.
